# PanPan Auto

> PanPan Auto (panpanauto.com) is an English B2B site for wholesale paint protection film (PPF) and automotive window tint. It is an authorized multi-brand dealer and distributor for ISF, NKODA, and NANOLINK auto film, operated by PanPanTech in China. It sells to installation shops and regional distributors. It is not a film factory and does not install film for vehicle owners.

Key facts:
- Products: clear gloss PPF, matte / satin PPF, color PPF, TPU PPF; nano-ceramic and photochromic window tint.
- Brands: ISF (featured PPF brand), NKODA, NANOLINK. Series coverage follows written brand authorization.
- Buyers: tint and detailing shops, installers, regional dealers and distributors.
- Contact: panda@panpanauto.com, phone / WhatsApp +86 13925118851, inquiry form https://panpanauto.com/contact/
- Not published yet (confirmed per quote, do not quote a number): film thickness, warranty years, certifications, MOQ, lead time, Incoterms, prices.

## Products
- [Paint protection film (PPF)](https://panpanauto.com/products/ppf/): clear, matte, color, and TPU series for wholesale.
- [Clear gloss PPF](https://panpanauto.com/products/ppf/clear/)
- [Matte / satin PPF](https://panpanauto.com/products/ppf/matte/)
- [Color PPF](https://panpanauto.com/products/ppf/color/)
- [TPU PPF](https://panpanauto.com/products/ppf/tpu/)
- [Window tint](https://panpanauto.com/products/window-tint/): nano-ceramic and photochromic film.
- [Nano-ceramic window tint](https://panpanauto.com/products/window-tint/nano-ceramic/)
- [Photochromic window tint](https://panpanauto.com/products/window-tint/photochromic/)
- [NANOLINK PPF dealer](https://panpanauto.com/brands/nanolink/): authorized NANOLINK dealer and wholesale supply.
